validation_selection.rule: retain at least 80% of raw numeric and definite-answer effects; do not increase baseline-wrong numeric confidence beyond raw; do not worsen Brier beyond max(0, raw); then minimize absolute language effect and ambiguous definite-answer forcing

interpretation_constraints: Projection overlap is geometric and is not interpreted as a causal effect fraction.
All nominal doses are selected on validation to match a common output KL budget.
The test partition is not used for lambda selection or dose matching.
Random-control cells share benchmark examples and are not independent replications.
